brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A pan-fired green tea from the Ending tea farm in Fuzhou, Fujian, made from improved clonal cultivars.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
history: It was developed in 1990 and sells mainly in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Shanghai and the Beijing-Tianjin area. Little more is documented about it.
processing: Withered, spread, fixed at high heat, shaped, then dried slowly at low heat.
harvest_season: Mid-March, one bud with one just-opening leaf.
appearance_dry: Plump, straight shoots with prominent downy tips.
taste_profile: High aroma and a mellow, full taste.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
